correctness.rationale: The full quotient is obtained by attaching all triangle orbits to a star-shaped edge quotient. Nontrivial face stabilizers are exactly reflections, and their half-triangle/mirror edge pairs cancel; free triangle orbits add S^2. Consecutive triples are reflection-fixed, and unique-edge triples normalize to k=3,...,n-2 modulo k->n+1-k, leaving floor((n-4)/2) free orbits. This proves all n>=4, not by extrapolation. An independent exact quotient barycentric chain/Smith computation and direct stabilizer count pass for 4<=n<=20 with zero H1 and no torsion.

value.rationale: This is a complete, all-order integral homotopy classification for the canonical full automorphism quotient of a natural graph-tolerance family. It shows quotient simple connectivity and absence of torsion and quantifies quadratic-to-linear sphere-rank loss; neither the nonequivariant homotopy result nor rational character averaging supplies these conclusions.
